title: Japanese-Style Ochazuke Rice Bowl
description: A traditional Japanese dish made with steamed rice, green tea, and various toppings. This recipe is a simple and comforting breakfast or snack option.
instructions: 1. Cook the Yellowish Japanese Rice according to package instructions.
2. In a separate pot, heat the Gooey Green Tea to a safe temperature (not boiling).
3. In a small bowl, mix together the Dried Wakame Seaweed, Sesame Seeds, Grated Daikon Radish, and Sliced Scallions.
4. To assemble the Ochazuke, place a scoop of the cooked rice into a bowl, followed by a drizzle of the green tea.
5. Top the rice with the seaweed mixture and any additional toppings of your choice.
